---
title: "Open-Source Software"
---

My software is designed to give you a clear lens to see your own reality. While the math behind these tools is technical, the final results shouldn't be. 
**If you look at the final maps or graphs using my tools and they don't make intuitive sense to your lived experience, that is a failure of my software— not your intelligence.** I would be so glad if we could update these tools together by submitting an issue to their repositories.
